retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic nocturnal layout featuring a low-angle shot of a neon-lit building against a dark sky with bold, condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition dominated by a deep charcoal sky, featuring a small, brightly lit neon diner in the lower-left quadrant and large-scale, high-contrast condensed typography across the upper half.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the tiny distant diner and the massive foreground text
Color harmony between the orange neon signage and the orange title text
Horizontal division between the dark ground/sky and the vibrant graphic overlays
Vertical alignment of the tracklist against the right margin
coreInvariants: Orange as the primary title color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The diner is positioned in the lower-left, occupying roughly 15% of the frame; the title dominates the upper 30%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange title text acts as the primary anchor, while the neon diner provides a secondary point of interest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large title, move down to the neon building, then scan the vertical list on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the center and upper-right creates a moody, nocturnal atmosphere.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric Blue (Neon accents and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, high-saturation text and neon pop against a low-value, desaturated background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to orange, blue, and white on black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence of the title.
Provides the clean, condensed uppercase look for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle night photograph of a small roadside diner with glowing orange and blue neon signs, set against a vast, dark, empty landscape and a deep charcoal sky. Leave the top half of the frame mostly empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, orange condensed sans-serif title in the upper-left. Below it, add a vertical list of names in a smaller, white condensed sans-serif font aligned to the right side.

verificationChecks: Does the orange text match the neon glow?
Is the typography strictly condensed sans-serif?
Is the diner positioned in the lower-left quadrant?

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the neon building
Verify the orange hue is vibrant and not muddy
Check that the vertical list is perfectly aligned
Confirm the background sky is a uniform dark tone
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal Scene + Condensed Sans-Serif + Orange/Blue Neon Palette = Cinematic Soundtrack Aesthetic
